The '''Baldavia system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Gallinore system/Legends|Gallinore]] and [[Theselon system/Legends|Theselon systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Baldavia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as the [[Baldavian pocket hare]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and was the origin point of the group known as [[Baldavian lip-reader]]s.<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Baldavia system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
